method: Greedy generation on the official gretelai/synthetic_text_to_sql finance test split; per-example SQLite context execution comparison and normalized exact SQL match.

failure_examples.question: What are the names and total transactions of all Shariah-compliant financial institutions from the finance database?
failure_examples.predicted: SELECT name, SUM(total_transactions) FROM shariah_compliant_institutions GROUP BY name;

failure_examples.question: List the names and account balances for customers who have both a Shariah-compliant mortgage and a socially responsible loan?
failure_examples.predicted: SELECT customer_name, account_balance FROM (SELECT customer_name, account_balance, mortgage_id FROM shariah_mortgages UNION SELECT customer_name, account_balance, loan_id FROM shariah_loans UNION SELECT customer_name, account_balance, mortgage_id FROM socially_responsible_loans) WHERE mortgage_id IS NOT NULL;
failure_examples.expected: SELECT sm.customer_name, sm.account_balance FROM shariah_mortgages sm JOIN shariah_loans sl ON sm.mortgage_id = sl.mortgage_id JOIN socially_responsible_loans srl ON sm.customer_id = srl.customer_id;

failure_examples.question: Rank customers by total deposits in Shariah-compliant accounts, with ties given the same rank.
failure_examples.predicted: SELECT customer_id, SUM(balance) as total_deposits, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_deposits DESC) as rank FROM deposits WHERE account_type = 'Shariah-compliant' GROUP BY customer_id;
failure_examples.expected: SELECT customer_id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(balance) DESC) as deposit_rank FROM deposits WHERE account_type = 'Shariah-compliant' GROUP BY customer_id;
